specRef: SPEC §8 measured pixel/perceptual tolerances; Appendix C3 render parity

textSizeEnvelope.statement: Text at or above 14.4 px rendered height keeps >= 30 dB regionally at quality high (all tested sizes >= that height passed; the smallest failing tested height is none px).
textSizeEnvelope.caveat: One synthetic scene (white text with black stroke over saturated flat colour edges incl. a yellow flash band) on one encoder setting (x264 crf per quality high, 4:2:0). Not a general guarantee.

test2.method: PSNR over all RGB samples; SSIM computed in-process on BT.709 luma, 8x8 uniform window, stride 4, L=255, k1=0.01, k2=0.03; export decoded with ffmpeg scale=in_color_matrix=bt709:in_range=limited to rgb24
